sections.description:
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 12 OF 1979
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 12 OF 1979
HOUSES OF PARLIAMENT AND
PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLIES (ELECTIONS) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 18th August 1979]
No. F.17(2)/79-Pub.-The following Order made by the
President is hereby published for general information :-
In pursuance of the Proclamation of the fifth day of
July, 1977, read with the Laws (Continuance in Force) Order, 1977 (C. M. L. A.
Order No. 1 of 1977), and in exercise of all powers enabling him in that
behalf, the President is pleased to make the following Order :-
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This
Order may be called the Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies
(Elections) (Amendment) Order, 1979.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
2. Amendment of Article 10,
P. (P. P.) O. 5 of 1977.-In
the Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1977 [P.
(P. P.) O. 5 of 1977], in Article 10, in clause (2), after paragraph (aa) the
following new paragraph shall be inserted, namely :-
"(aaa) if, being a citizen of Pakistan by virtue
of section 14-B of the Pakistan Citizenship Act, 1951 (II of 1951), he is for
the time being disqualified under any law in force in Azad Jammu & Kashmir
from being elected as a member of the Legislative Assembly of Azad Jammu &
Kashmir; or",
